title: State store shared definitions
description: The ONE record envelope every kind carries (shared/state-store.xml#envelope): identity, time, kind, code and writing node, plus seq and hash that N-01 adds at commit. A record on input has no seq; a committed record has it (committed_envelope). The idempotency key, the fencing token and the expected entity version are not envelope fields: they ride on the put request (nodes/N-01/record.schema.json#/$defs/record_put). Node schemas $ref #/$defs/envelope (or committed_envelope) and add their body fields. The id form is the UTC-stamp form N-01 owns; see rejected-with-reason.xml#envelope-id-form for the r-prefixed form that was rejected.

id.description: UTC stamp, the status code, five lowercase alphanumerics; unique per writer

at.description: UTC, second precision; assigned by N-01 at commit when absent on input

kind.description: lowercase, dotted where it has parts (lease.granted); a line-op kind such as dispatch or merge is one segment; registered in state-store.xml#record-kinds-registry

code.description: a value of shared/status-codes.xml#codes; N-01 validates against the live code table, this enum is the book's copy

ticket.description: A work order id, or CR-<request id> for a cut request that N-03 admitted from a ticket.request (nodes/N-03/spec.xml#input)

lease_token.description: fencing token from entity counter:lease_token; only grows; the put request carries it, a lease body names it token (nodes/N-02/record.schema.json#/$defs/lease_body)

idempotency_key.description: caller-chosen, unique per intended effect: node id, colon, input record id, colon, step name; same key same payload replays 200, a different payload is 409 record.conflict

schema_version.description: optional marker of the envelope generation; when present it is 2.0.0

by.description: node id or seat id that wrote the record

seq.description: assigned by N-01 at commit; never on input

committed_envelope.description: The envelope as stored and read back: seq is present (N-01 assigns seq and hash at commit; hash is required on record.committed, nodes/N-01/record.schema.json#/$defs/record_committed)
